description: Player character v1: adult woman warped off the train in torn modern travel clothes with a rope coil. Occupation-neutral; the eight PRD occupations become outfit and starting-skill variants later.

pipeline.note: walk.glb and run.glb are the free rig outputs. Meshy preset animations arrive as full skinned GLBs, one per clip, matching the creature contract layout.

clip_notes.attack_primary: Thrust Slash (knife). 3.0 s, trim to the strike in-engine or play at 1.5x
clip_notes.attack_heavy: Heavy Hammer Swing, overhead two-hand, 1.9 s: the wind-up is the telegraph
clip_notes.gather: Female Crouch Pick Up Place Side, 9.6 s: use the first ~2 s for a gather loop
clip_notes.mount_idle: Chair Sit Idle, 11.4 s loop: seated riding pose
clip_notes.knockdown: Knock Down 2.5 s, holds on the ground
